purpose: Keep a state unchanged while something else happens.
keywords: た-form / ない-form + まま; noun + のまま; な-adjective + なまま.
I entered the room with my shoes still on.
I fell asleep with the window left open.
I went home without saying anything.
formation: た-form / ない-form + まま; noun + のまま; な-adjective + なまま.
restrictions: The retained state must make sense alongside the main action.
mistake: ている normally describes a state itself; まま emphasizes leaving it unchanged.
